usedFor: humanitix holds events, orders and attendees, and HubSpot receives each buyer as a contact through “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Attendes” in humanitix, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It collects details per ticket, so each guest becomes a contact, not only the person who paid.

watchOut: “New Attendes” runs once per attendee and is polling, so one order creates many runs after a scheduled check.
